verdict.rationale: The MI325X ships with first-party management and monitoring software (AMD SMI, GPU Operator, Device Metrics Exporter, Spur scheduler), and such tooling could plausibly offer event webhooks, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Prometheus-format metrics are pull-based, which is an adjacent feature, not webhook subscriptions, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.
